description: This file defines the foreign function interface (FFI) for TPM-related functions, intended for use by Rust code. It exposes C functions for TPM HMAC operations and logging, with appropriate include guards and C linkage.
external_files: No other external files referenced directly in code past includes

methods.name: tpm_hmac
methods.description: Computes an HMAC using TPM and provides the result via an output buffer. Returns 0 for success and 1 for error.

methods.name: secure_env_log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified severity level, including file and line information.
